sample.text: Eastbank High graduate Leo Ortega, back from a hamstring injury, delivered the deciding hit in the 11th inning of the Harbor City Gulls' 5-4 win over Ridgeview on Tuesday. Ortega's former coach, Rick Delaney, watched from the third-base seats with a dozen current Eastbank players.
